title: State Bank of India SBI Specialist Cadre Trade Finance Officer TFO Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for 35 Post
postName: SBI Specialist Cadre Trade Finance Officer (TFO) Recruitment 2026
vacancyDetails: Trade Finance Officer - IBG (TFO-IBG) / JMGS-I: 14 posts; Trade Finance Officer - IBG (TFO-IBG) / MMGS-II: 21 posts; total 35 vacancies.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any stream and certification in Forex Operations from IIBF, with relevant experience as per the official SBI TFO 2026 notice.
ageLimit: JMGS-I: 21-30 years; MMGS-II: 23-32 years as on 31/07/2026. Relaxations as per SBI rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹750; SC / ST / PH: ₹0. Pay through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI only.
selectionProcess: Online application → Shortlisting / Interview / Selection as per SBI Specialist Cadre recruitment process
documentsRequired: Scanned photograph, signature, ID proof, educational certificates, experience proof and any other documents as required by SBI.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official SBI recruitment portal
2. Register and complete the application form
3. Fill personal, educational and experience details
4. Upload the required documents
5. Pay the application fee, if applicable
6. Submit the application and save the printout
shortDescription: SBI Specialist Cadre Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 online form is open for 35 posts. Apply online from 29 August to 28 September 2026.
content:
State Bank of India (SBI) has released the Specialist Cadre Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 notification for the selection of 35 officers.

Candidates can submit their online application from 29/08/2026 to 28/09/2026 through the official SBI recruitment portal.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 29/08/2026
  • Last date to apply: 28/09/2026
  • Fee payment last date: 28/09/2026
  • Exam date: As per schedule
  • Admit card: Before exam

Vacancy details

  • Trade Finance Officer – IBG (TFO-IBG) / JMGS-I: 14 posts
  • Trade Finance Officer – IBG (TFO-IBG) / MMGS-II: 21 posts

Read the official SBI TFO 2026 recruitment notice and complete the online form before the deadline.
